game.name: Twill Studio
game.desc: Twill Studio is a groovebox made for handhelds. Songs are written in a piano roll built for buttons: a cursor and held-button chords place, stretch and move notes quickly. Each track is a synth built on Emilie Gillet's open-source eurorack code (MIT), a sampler, a drum kit or a MIDI output, with a filter, envelopes and four modulators. Clips are arranged into songs, sounds and effects can be automated, and the mixer has reverb, delay, chorus, EQ, a compressor and a limiter. Songs render to WAV, and USB MIDI keyboards and synths play along.
